about: The Crate: free tools in their class, set up for you and played by Tempo. winget ids and Homebrew names were checked against the winget-pkgs and Homebrew trees on 2026-11-07. apt names and install folders were not tried on a real machine; a tool whose names or folders are a guess carries verified:false and says why. Each licence is the project's own, as Homebrew lists it where it does. No pinned downloads ship yet: they need a SHA-256 copied from a release. The code that checks one is in, and the tests run it.

tools.name: Blender
tools.for: 3D modelling, animation and rendering. Tempo renders scenes with no window.
tools.tempo: Renders a scene to an image with `blender -b`, or runs a Python script you have read and approved.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07. The apt package is Debian's own, older than the current release.

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.for: Make images from a prompt with local diffusion models.

windows.manual: ComfyUI has no package. Download the portable build from the releases page of the homepage and unpack it.

macos.manual: Follow the install steps on the homepage (it runs from a Python environment).

linux.manual: Follow the install steps on the homepage (it runs from a Python environment).

tools.tempo: Already wired in: the agent's `comfy_image` tool makes one image and gives the graphics card back after. Set `comfy_url` in the agent's config to switch it on.
tools.note: No package manager has it, so `crate add` only points at the install steps. Size is ComfyUI plus one checkpoint. Detection is the agent's `comfy_url` setting, not a program on PATH.

tools.name: FFmpeg
tools.for: Convert, cut and fix any video or audio file.
tools.licence: LGPL-2.1-or-later (GPL-2.0-or-later or GPL-3.0 in builds with more codecs)
tools.tempo: Converts between formats with three presets, and trims a clip by time.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07. Homebrew's build is GPL-3.0-or-later.

tools.name: ImageMagick
tools.for: Resize and convert pictures in bulk, from the command line.
tools.tempo: Resizes a picture to a width or height, and converts between PNG, JPEG, WebP and more.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07. On Windows only `magick` counts, because `convert` is a different program there. Debian ships ImageMagick 6, where the program is `convert`.

tools.name: Inkscape
tools.for: Draw and edit vector graphics (logos, icons, diagrams).
tools.tempo: Exports an SVG to PNG or PDF at the size you ask for.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07.

tools.name: GIMP
tools.for: Edit photos and paint, with scripts for batch work.
tools.tempo: Listed for now: GIMP runs scripts with `gimp -i -b`, which suits batch edits, but Tempo does not drive it yet. Krita has no comparable batch mode, so GIMP is the pick.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07. The program name differs by version and OS, so the detection names and paths are a guess until tried on each.

tools.name: SoX
tools.for: Clean up, trim and normalise sound files.
tools.tempo: Brings a recording to a steady peak level.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07. The Windows package is the old 14.4.2 build.

tools.name: whisper.cpp
tools.for: Turn speech into text on your own computer, nothing uploaded.

windows.manual: No winget package. Download the Windows zip (whisper-bin-x64) from the releases page of the homepage.

linux.manual: No apt package that Tempo has checked. Build it from the homepage, or download a release.

tools.tempo: Writes out what is said in an audio file. It needs one model file in the Crate's models folder (the base English one is about 150 MB).
tools.note: Homebrew formula `whisper.cpp` checked on 2026-11-07 (MIT). Nothing found for winget or apt, so Windows and Linux are by hand. The program is `whisper-cli` in current releases.

tools.name: Piper
tools.for: Read text aloud with a natural local voice.
tools.tempo: Turns a short text into a WAV file. It needs one voice file in the Crate's models folder (about 60 MB).
tools.note: PyPI package `piper-tts` 1.8.0 checked on 2026-11-07 (GPL-3.0-or-later). Needs Python and pipx first. The `piper` program name and its `-m`/`-f` flags were not run here.

tools.name: Pandoc
tools.for: Turn documents into other documents: Markdown, Word, HTML, EPUB.
tools.tempo: Converts a document between Markdown, Word, OpenDocument, HTML, EPUB and plain text.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07. PDF output needs a LaTeX engine, so Tempo hands PDFs to LibreOffice when it has it.

tools.name: LibreOffice
tools.for: Open, edit and convert Word, Excel and PowerPoint files, free.
tools.tempo: Converts office files to PDF and other formats with no window.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07.

tools.name: Tesseract
tools.for: Read the text in a scan or a screenshot (OCR).
tools.tempo: Reads the text out of a picture and hands it back. Read-only.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07. English comes with it; other languages are separate downloads.

tools.name: yt-dlp
tools.for: Download video or audio you have the right to keep.
tools.tempo: Listed only: you run it yourself, on media you have the right to download. Tempo does not drive it.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07. Sites change often, so it needs updating more than most; the apt package lags behind.

tools.name: OBS Studio
tools.for: Record your screen or stream, with scenes and sources.
tools.tempo: App only: you press record. Tempo does not drive it.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07. It has no version command that is safe to run, so only 'installed' is shown.

tools.name: Godot
tools.for: Make 2D and 3D games with a free engine.

linux.manual: Download the Linux build from the homepage (Debian only packages the older Godot 3).

tools.tempo: Listed for now: Godot can export projects from the command line, but Tempo does not drive it yet.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07. The Windows program name after install was not checked.

tools.name: FreeCAD
tools.for: Design parts you can build, with parametric 3D CAD.
tools.tempo: Listed for now: FreeCAD scripts in Python, which Tempo does not run yet.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07. Install folder names are a guess.

tools.name: OpenSCAD
tools.for: Describe a 3D part in code and get a printable model.
tools.tempo: Turns a .scad file into an STL, 3MF or picture.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07. Both of those are the 2021.01 release; Debian's is newer. The licence is GPL-2.0-or-later with a linking exception for CGAL.

tools.name: KiCad
tools.for: Design circuit boards, from schematic to fabrication files.
tools.tempo: Listed for now: `kicad-cli` can export Gerbers and PDFs, which Tempo does not drive yet.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07. The install folder names are a guess.

tools.name: Ollama
tools.for: Run language models on your own computer.

linux.manual: Run `tempo-launch setup --ollama`: Tempo fetches its own pinned copy and checks its SHA-256.

tools.tempo: Already the engine: `tempo-launch setup` picks models for it. See setup for the pinned copy Tempo can fetch itself.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07. Linked to Tempo's own setup (catalog/runtime.json).

tools.name: ripgrep
tools.for: Search every file in a folder in a blink.
tools.tempo: Finds text in your files, with line numbers. Read-only.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07. Homebrew lists only the Unlicense; the project is dual-licensed.

tools.name: fd
tools.for: Find files by name, fast.
tools.tempo: Listed only: a quicker way to find files for you, not driven by Tempo.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07. Debian calls the program `fdfind`.

tools.name: ExifTool
tools.for: Read and fix the hidden details inside photos, videos and audio.
tools.tempo: Reads the camera, date and location details out of a file. Read-only.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew formula checked on 2026-11-07.

tools.name: Audacity
tools.for: Record and edit sound by hand.
tools.tempo: App only: Audacity has no command line worth driving. For batch audio, use SoX.
tools.note: winget id and Homebrew cask checked on 2026-11-07. Version 4 is a GPL-3.0 release; the project says GPL-2.0-or-later for earlier ones.
